disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码、浏览器构建产物、挂载配置与文档，未发现 API Key、令牌、私钥、钱包助记词等敏感凭据的硬编码或读取逻辑，命中 0。

checked_items.en: No access to sensitive paths such as system credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credential directories was found; the browser side only reads display content such as approval reasons and question text from session snapshots to compose notification text, and does not touch the credential surface.

checked_items.zh: 未发现凭据枚举、云身份探测或钱包相关操作。
checked_items.en: No credential enumeration, cloud identity probing, or wallet-related operations were found.

evidence.en: This plugin has no network communication at all, nor does it read sensitive paths such as system credential files or SSH private keys—the browser side only reads approval reasons and question text from session snapshots for notification text, so the credential exfiltration scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现 AGENTS、SKILL、CLAUDE 等 agent 指令文件，也未发现隐藏注释或不可见字符中藏匿的指令文本，命中 0。

checked_items.en: All documentation including the English/Chinese README, changelog, security notes, and contribution guidelines was read; all content is routine installation, usage, and project description, with no wording that overrides instructions, disguises system messages, induces installation, or pulls remote instructions.

checked_items.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，也没有向系统提示注入文本的调用；浏览器侧只注册中/英两个语言字典和一个设置行，文案均为通知功能说明。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not register any tools and has no calls that inject text into the system prompt; the browser side only registers Chinese and English language dictionaries and one settings row, all of which are notification feature descriptions.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，也没有向系统提示注入文本的调用；浏览器侧仅注册语言字典与设置行（src/client/index.ts、src/client/locales.ts），文案均为通知功能说明，无指令性内容。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any tools and has no calls that inject text into the system prompt; the browser side only registers language dictionaries and a settings row (src/client/index.ts, src/client/locales.ts), all of which are notification feature descriptions with no instructional content.

evidence.en: The installation and upgrade commands in the README are routine user documentation (dsh plugin add/update), which does not enter the model context, and contain no wording that induces installation, rewrites configuration, or relaxes permissions.

checked_items.en: No execution primitives such as eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess calls were found in the runtime source or build artifacts; the browser bundle matches the source line by line, with no injection or tampering.

evidence.en: The only YAML config in the entire tree, cordis.patch.yml, only performs one routine plugin registration, contains no executable JS scalars, and does not present a patch-as-execution surface.

evidence.en: No dynamic code execution primitives (eval, dynamic function construction, subprocess, etc.) were found in the runtime source or build artifacts, and no dynamic package tools are invoked.

evidence.en: package.json declares no install hooks; the build artifact is committed with the package, so installation does not require a build; the tree contains no execution carriers such as git hooks, CI workflows, devcontainer, or Makefile; development scripts are not shipped with the package.

evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side entry (dsh.client in package.json); its bundle matches the source line by line: it only uses the system notification API and session reads, with no keyboard listeners, clipboard access, or privileged calls.

checked_items.zh: 全树运行时代码未发现任何网络请求、WebSocket、DNS 外联或外发通道，也无 curl/wget 类命令行外发与编码后外发链路，命中 0。
checked_items.en: No network requests, WebSocket, DNS outbound connections, or exfiltration channels were found in the runtime code across the whole tree, nor curl/wget-type command-line exfiltration or encoded exfiltration chains. Hit count: 0.

checked_items.en: The only external surface on the browser side is the system desktop notification API (local popups after user authorization), which does not involve network transmission; no endpoint hijacking or proxy rewriting was found.

evidence.zh: 运行时代码没有任何网络请求、WebSocket 或外发通道，不存在凭据外泄的网络路径，本场景不适用。
evidence.en: The runtime code has no network requests, WebSocket, or exfiltration channels; there is no network path for credential exfiltration, so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.en: The patch config only registers the plugin entry, does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no disabling, privilege-lowering, or environment-variable-lowering patterns.

evidence.en: The plugin does not register any event listeners related to the approval chain, so there is no possibility of truncating or short-circuiting the approval chain.

evidence.en: This is the initial audit with no prior version baseline to compare, so it is impossible to evaluate upgrade auto-activation or capability declaration changes; this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration, presenting no tampering surface that would break other plugins' service dependencies.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口；浏览器侧行为仅为页面隐藏且用户授权时弹系统通知，点击通知回到对应会话，无宿主篡改或特权调用。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on any port; the browser-side behavior is limited to hiding the page and showing a system notification when the user authorizes it; clicking the notification returns to the corresponding session, with no host tampering or privileged calls.

checked_items.zh: 本次未做动态沙箱运行验证，运行时结论基于静态全量审读；插件为纯浏览器 UI 通知功能，与 dsh 宿主固有 RPC 风险无新增面。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox runtime verification was performed this time; runtime conclusions are based on static full review; the plugin is a pure browser UI notification feature and adds no new surface to the inherent RPC risk of the dsh host.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，不新增本机无认证 RPC 面；该场景仅作为宿主固有风险存在，与本插件无关。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on any port, and adds no local unauthenticated RPC surface; this scenario only exists as an inherent host risk and is unrelated to this plugin.

summary.en: AI metadata review passed: no tool description poisoning, no system prompt injection, no abnormal capability declarations.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（本次运行无动态产物）。

limits.zh: 本插件无显式能力清单文件，declared_capabilities 按代码实测推断（纯浏览器通知 UI，无网络/Shell/文件系统/模型上下文面）。未做动态沙箱验证，兼容性仅静态核查（CHANGELOG 声明适配 dsh 20260812 快照）。机械扫描命中 3 条全部人工复核为良性：lib/client.js.map:1 的 DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）为 tsdown 生成的源码映射文件（含插件自身源码与标准映射，属生成产物，内容核实无混淆无隐藏代码）；scripts/build.mjs:11 与 scripts/verify-i18n.mjs:6 的 DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）仅存在于开发期脚本（未随包发布，package.json 的 files 列表不含 scripts/），只调用本地工具链（tsc/tsdown/git hash-object），无远程内容、无运行时执行。README 给出的安装命令未钉 commit 属文档习惯，市场安装命令已按平台规则钉定 commit。
limits.en: This plugin has no explicit capability manifest file; declared_capabilities is inferred from code measurements (pure browser notification UI, with no network/Shell/filesystem/model-context surface). No dynamic sandbox verification was performed; compatibility was only statically checked (CHANGELOG declares adaptation to the dsh 20260812 snapshot). All 3 mechanical scan hits were manually reviewed and found benign: lib/client.js.map:1's DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) is a source map file generated by tsdown (containing the plugin's own source and standard mapping; it is a generated artifact, and its content verified to contain no obfuscation or hidden code); scripts/build.mjs:11 and scripts/verify-i18n.mjs:6's DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) exist only in development scripts (not shipped with the package; the files list in package.json does not include scripts/), only invoking the local toolchain (tsc/tsdown/git hash-object), with no remote content and no runtime execution. The install command given in the README does not pin a commit, which is a documentation habit; the market install command pins a commit per platform rules.
